# RankFixer
> Open-source AI visibility platform for GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Analyze websites for LLM readability and get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

## Why RankFixer Exists

AI engines now answer questions that used to drive search traffic. If your site isn't structured for machine comprehension, you're invisible to the fastest-growing discovery channel.

RankFixer bridges the gap between traditional SEO and Generative Engine Optimization.

## Free Tools

- [AI Visibility Checker](https://rankfixer.co/ai-visibility-checker): Scan any domain and see how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini describe your brand
- [Schema Generator](https://rankfixer.co/schema-generator): Generate valid FAQPage + Organization JSON-LD
- [llms.txt Validator](https://rankfixer.co/llms-txt-validator): Check whether your domain publishes a well-formed llms.txt file
- [Visibility Tracker](https://rankfixer.co/visibility-tracker): Track your AI Visibility Score over time
